title: AIR Grounding Method Pack v2
description: Reusable evidence-gated Grounding method for translating ambitious or uncertain work into a viable, proportionate, source-bounded execution path while preserving challenge, claim hygiene, regulatory pressure, method state, user workflow, and handoff safety.

authority_boundary.operative_use_rule: Use only after exact identity and dependency validation, task-fit selection, explicit approval when required, and compilation into or explicit reference by the sole bound Orbit 0 AIR_ARTIFACT.

required_input_acquisition_contract.behavior: Check current session and validated package inventory first; request the smallest exact missing component, source, tool, connector, credential class, approval, clarification, or action; request the complete five-file Grounding package when coupled use or package validation is required.
required_input_acquisition_contract.attachment_boundary: Receipt establishes availability only, not selection, approval, binding, or execution authority.

test_evidence_contract.presentation_only_rule: The -t modifier controls evidence presentation and packaging only. It does not reduce evidence acquisition requirements, evidence preservation, cognitive work, benchmark rigor, review obligations, acceptance criteria, or closure requirements.
test_evidence_contract.standard_presentation_rule: Show decision, scoped counts, evidence classes, material failures, claim boundary and sufficient evidence references without omitting evidence required to justify the decision.
test_evidence_contract.expanded_presentation_rule: Surface available reviewable evidence artifacts and references when those artifacts exist and may be disclosed.
test_evidence_contract.retroactivity_rule: Presentation mode may reveal already preserved evidence but must not fabricate missing historical evidence. A new authorized run is required when evidence itself is missing for an applicable acceptance, regulatory or reproducibility obligation, not merely because standard presentation was used.
test_evidence_contract.regulatory_rule: Required regulatory/test evidence must exist regardless of presentation mode; missing qualifying evidence remains REVIEW or EVIDENCE_REQUIRED.
test_evidence_contract.rights_and_reasoning_boundary: Do not expose hidden reasoning, private chain of thought, secrets, credentials, restricted source text or unavailable backend logs.

knowledge_to_execution_path_contract.approval_boundary: APPROVE requires COMPLETE_FOR_ACTIVE_STEP; missing required stages route to REVIEW or REJECT.
knowledge_to_execution_path_contract.hidden_reasoning_boundary: Use declared criteria, evidence and observable checks; do not request or expose private chain of thought.

execution_namespace_boundary.k2e_execution_stage_semantics: Required task operation inside the knowledge-to-execution/cognitive benchmark path.
execution_namespace_boundary.operative_action_rule: Any material action under Core RT.ACTION requires a current bound artifact, ACTIVE lease, matching resource scope pin when material, current approval and AIR_GATE ALLOW, then one matching single-use AIR_ACTION_AUTHORIZATION for exactly one declared effect attempt; after the attempt, post-effect alignment and Core RT.RECEIPT must construct AIR_ACTION_RECEIPT before dependent action, delivery, or closure.

new_task_boundary_revalidation.trigger: Core NEW_TASK_BOUNDARY, Orbit 0 task-identity replacement, or binding of a different task AIR_ARTIFACT
new_task_boundary_revalidation.effect: Prior task-operative Grounding method_execution_state, completed/blocked/invalidated step state, evidence-to-advance conclusions, gate effects, and execution-specific benchmark contribution become non-operative for the new task.
new_task_boundary_revalidation.required_recovery: Re-enter G01 under the newly bound task AIR_ARTIFACT and revalidate applicability before any prior method state can become operative.
new_task_boundary_revalidation.mii_effect: Prior-task Grounding contribution refs, risk graphs, cognitive-route recommendations and morphology recommendations become historical/candidate input only until revalidated under the newly bound task artifact.

method_completion_boundary: Method-step completion is not proof that the project task executed correctly, passed external validation, achieved compliance, or is release-ready.

non_activation_conditions: single low-risk conversational answer with no method-governed advancement
one-off exploratory work where method state does not affect closure or approval
creative brainstorming with no execution, evidence, claim, handoff, or rescope pressure

claim_boundary: This Method Pack standardizes review procedure only. It does not prove execution, backend validation, empirical improvement, compliance, safety, production readiness, or tool execution. It also does not classify the user or override user-approved working agreements, AIR_GATE, bound Orbit 0 artifact contracts, or evidence requirements.

user_alignment_and_execution_workflow_re.core_rule: When this Method Pack reviews method-governed output, it must check delivery-form fit against user_execution_workflow if that workflow materially affects implementation, approval, closure, or handoff.

executor_method_boundary_review.executor: small bounded callable operation with light/local state burden
executor_method_boundary_review.method_pack: governed repeatable procedure with evidence gates, method execution state, staleness, portability, templates, or handoff relevance
promote_executor_to_method_when: defect or rework history justifies promotion

air_discovery_executor_policy.core_principle: AIR must help discover missing decision frames, constraints, source requirements, dependency state, and unknown unknowns before material execution when the user cannot reasonably know them yet.
trigger_when: user objective is broad, underdefined, exploratory, or source-light
decision context is missing or unclear
market, jurisdiction, audience, product stage, budget, time horizon, release posture, or claim boundary may materially affect output
source authority, tool access, repo state, API access, credential state, or dependency availability is unclear
user likely cannot know which specialist, domain package, method, executor, source, or external skill/tool is needed
execution would otherwise require silent assumptions
air_discovery_executor_policy.dependency_boundary: AIR does not depend on the user finding the correct prebuilt external skill. AIR may infer the needed capability/source map and generate retrieval instructions. AIR is not data-independent: external evidence, repositories, files, APIs, tools, connectors, credentials, or current data may still be required for execution, approval, or claims.

patch_source_upload_gate_policy.core_principle: Before AIR executes a patch, AIR must request and use the files to be patched in the current session. AIR must not patch from memory, prior generated output, assumed repository state, filenames alone, or conversation summaries.
requirements: visibly request or confirm the exact patch-source set before material patch execution
surface the expected source files and the uploaded/current-session files AIR intends to use
treat uploaded files after request, or explicit user confirmation after source inventory, as patch-source gate evidence
use only the uploaded/current-session files as patch source of truth
inspect or parse the uploaded files before patching
preserve complete replacement file delivery when the working agreement requires it
report which uploaded source files were used
do not claim repo alignment unless uploaded files or tool-observed repo state prove it
patch_source_upload_gate_policy.reason: Patching from memory is where hallucinations can mutate the result. Uploaded source files reduce that risk and create an explicit security checkpoint. The visible request/confirmation checkpoint prevents accidental mutation from files that happen to be present, stale assistant output, or remembered filenames.

source_layer.reason: The visible request/confirmation checkpoint prevents accidental mutation from files that happen to be present, stale assistant output, or remembered filenames.

material constraints that may change output
minimal next questions or retrieval instructions

list of output replacement files generated from uploaded sources
explicit REVIEW/EVIDENCE_REQUIRED state for missing expected files

procedure.action: Identify whether method_execution_state is required for the active task.
procedure.expected_output: Decision: required / optional / not needed, with reason.
procedure.evidence_to_advance: Task involves method-governed execution, review, approval, closure, handoff, mutation, rescope, Method Pack use, staleness, or promotion; otherwise mark not needed.
procedure.on_failure: If unclear, route to REVIEW and ask what action is being approved or closed.

procedure.action: Inspect method origin, active method id, active step, and step states.
procedure.expected_output: Method state summary with active, pending, completed, blocked, skipped, failed, invalidated, or stale states.
procedure.evidence_to_advance: method_execution_state fields or explicit statement that the field is missing but required.
procedure.on_failure: If required state is missing, return EVIDENCE_REQUIRED or REVIEW.

procedure.expected_output: Evidence sufficiency classification: sufficient / partial / missing / waived / invalid.
procedure.evidence_to_advance: Evidence entries with type, reference, summary, satisfies field, limitations, and turn/time when available.
procedure.on_failure: If evidence is missing or too weak for the active contract, return EVIDENCE_REQUIRED.

procedure.evidence_to_advance: method_step_gate, AIR_GATE decision if required, active contract scope/evidence requirements.
procedure.on_failure: If gates conflict, apply stricter gate and surface conflict.

procedure.action: Review Method Pack staleness when method_origin is FROM_METHOD_PACK or dependencies are material.
procedure.evidence_to_advance: dependency list, freshness requirement, last grounded evidence, re-ground trigger, and current evidence if approval depends on it.
procedure.on_failure: If stale or ungrounded, allow rough orientation only and block approval/closure/high-trust claims.

procedure.action: Review Method Pack promotion if promotion is proposed.
procedure.expected_output: Promotion recommendation: keep inline / promotion candidate / promote / do not promote.
procedure.evidence_to_advance: recurrence, low-variance need, portability need, template/asset need, defect/rework history, startup context cost, exploration constraint risk.
procedure.on_failure: If promotion is not justified, keep inline and record why.

procedure.action: Review whether the procedure should remain an Executor-level callable operation or justify Method Pack treatment.
procedure.expected_output: Classification: EXECUTOR_SUFFICIENT / METHOD_PACK_JUSTIFIED / KEEP_INLINE, with reason.
procedure.evidence_to_advance: Recurrence, evidence-gate need, method_execution_state need, staleness/dependency sensitivity, portability need, handoff preservation, template/asset need, or defect/rework history.
procedure.on_failure: If Method Pack justification is missing, keep the operation as an Executor or inline task-local procedure.

procedure.action: Produce closure, review, rejection, or rescope decision.
procedure.expected_output: Decision: ALLOW / REVIEW / EVIDENCE_REQUIRED / REJECT / RESCOPE_REQUIRED, with next allowed action.
procedure.evidence_to_advance: All method-state, evidence, gate, staleness, promotion, AIR_GATE, and active contract checks are reconciled.
procedure.on_failure: Do not approve; surface the blocking check and next allowed action.

procedure.action: Review output delivery form against user_execution_workflow when material.
procedure.expected_output: Delivery-form decision: matches workflow / review required / approval required to change / not material.
procedure.evidence_to_advance: user_execution_workflow mode and source authority, working agreement summary, or explicit skip/defer/provisional state.
procedure.on_failure: If delivery form conflicts with binding workflow, return REVIEW or regenerate in workflow-compliant form.

procedure.action: Review whether AIR_DISCOVERY_EXECUTOR or unknown-unknown discovery is required before approval, closure, mutation, or rescope.
procedure.expected_output: Decision: required / optional / not needed, with reason and minimal next questions if required.
procedure.evidence_to_advance: Decision frame, constraints, source/dependency state, and risk surfaces are sufficient for the requested method outcome, or missing items are routed to REVIEW/EVIDENCE_REQUIRED/PROVISIONAL_ALLOW.
procedure.on_failure: If material unknown unknowns remain, do not approve closure; return REVIEW, EVIDENCE_REQUIRED, or RESCOPE_REQUIRED.

procedure.action: For patching or documentation mutation, verify the visible patch-source request checkpoint and patch source upload gate were satisfied.
procedure.expected_output: Patch source gate decision: satisfied by upload after request / satisfied by user confirmation after inventory / missing files / mismatched files / memory-based or prior-output patch rejected.
procedure.evidence_to_advance: AIR visibly requested or confirmed the exact patch-source set before mutation; current-session uploaded files were inspected or parsed before patching; expected files are present or missing/mismatched files are surfaced as a gate.
procedure.on_failure: Reject memory-based or prior-output patching and restart from the visible patch-source request checkpoint.

integration_refresh.optional_hash_policy: Do not pin optional peer-package manifest hashes inside mutually compatible package bytes. Validate exact manifest identity, hash, version, dependencies and task fit at selection time to avoid cyclic hash invalidation.

core_route_ownership.grounding_effect: Grounding supplies candidate findings, cognitive contributions, risk propagation, challenge, evidence and required-input proposals. It does not create parallel Core routes or positive execution authority.

semantic_fidelity.rescope_rule: When grounding changes the task center, intended outcome, material scope, or acceptance criteria, propose RESCOPE_REQUIRED and route the change through Core. Grounding must not silently rewrite canonical intent.

mii_contribution_authority.operative_rule: Grounding Domain, Method, Specialist and Executor outputs have no independent execution, selection, approval, binding, delivery or closure authority. They become operative only after validation and compilation into or explicit reference by the sole bound Orbit 0 AIR_ARTIFACT.execution_benchmark_profile.

capability_ecology_peer.note: Observed T7 candidate identity is validation evidence for this reconciliation only; runtime selection must validate the then-supplied exact package and does not inherit this hash as binding authority.

mii_grounding_contribution_contract.fusion_boundary: Grounding may identify support/conflict edges and unresolved conflicts but Core MII owns contribution fusion and the AIR_ARTIFACT benchmark owns operative consumption.
mii_grounding_contribution_contract.authority_boundary: No Grounding cognitive route or contribution authorizes execution, action, delivery, closure, approval, binding or Orbit 0 occupancy.

semantic_fidelity_contract.grounding_rule: Grounding evaluates feasibility, claims, assumptions, consequences, risks and alternatives against resolved canonical intent and applicable context. It may challenge the proposed plan or recommend rescope but may not silently replace material intent, narrow/broaden scope, or reinterpret user-controlled values.
semantic_fidelity_contract.output_rule: Grounding contributions must identify any proposed benchmark effect and any material divergence from canonical intent/context. Material divergence routes to REVIEW or RESCOPE_REQUIRED before becoming operative.
semantic_fidelity_contract.raw_input_boundary: A translated or grounded interpretation never supersedes raw user input as evidence of what the user actually said.

epistemic_sufficiency_contract.invariant: Uncertainty creates an information-acquisition obligation, not an inference license.
epistemic_sufficiency_contract.grounding_behavior: When reliable continuation lacks sufficient basis, identify the exact missing basis and propose the smallest sufficient clarification, direction, source, evidence, current fact, environment state, artifact, permission, approval, capability, Specialist, or operator action.
epistemic_sufficiency_contract.non_material_uncertainty_rule: Proceed with a reversible labeled assumption only when alternative interpretations cannot materially alter correctness, scope, risk, evidence, authority, acceptance criteria or user intent.
epistemic_sufficiency_contract.tool_acquisition_rule: Do not ask the user for information Grounding/AIR can reliably obtain from available authorized evidence or tools.
epistemic_sufficiency_contract.likelihood_rule: Do not invent numeric likelihood or confidence. When probability/likelihood lacks adequate evidence, use UNKNOWN or an explicitly qualitative evidence-bounded state.

risk_propagation_contract.purpose: Represent adjacent blast radius as a propagation graph rather than a flat checklist when material.
risk_propagation_contract.likelihood_rule: Assess likelihood only when evidence supports it; otherwise likelihood = UNKNOWN. Do not fabricate numeric probabilities.
risk_propagation_contract.decision_effect: Material uncontrolled or unknown cascade risk may support REVIEW, EVIDENCE_REQUIRED, RESCOPE_REQUIRED or REJECT candidate recommendations; AIR_GATE remains Core-owned.

morphology_contribution_contract.observable_effect_requirement: Every recommendation must state the task/node objective and observable decomposition/review/pruning effect. Labels without effect are UNBOUND_DECORATIVE.
morphology_contribution_contract.claim_boundary: Grounding may not claim direct latent-space control, measured internal model effect, or BACKEND_BOUND morphology without evidence.

purpose: Reusable evidence-gated Grounding method for translating ambitious or uncertain work into a viable, proportionate, source-bounded execution path while preserving challenge, claim hygiene, regulatory pressure, method state, user workflow, and handoff safety.

review_triggers: Core NEW_TASK_BOUNDARY or Orbit 0 task identity changes
bound acceptance criteria or completion envelope changes materially
a required source, dependency, permission, or evidence basis changes materially
staleness_policy.behavior: Suspend affected method steps, revalidate the changed dependency, and invalidate downstream method evidence that depended on stale state.

handoff_requirements.continuation_rule: Restore method state only as continuation input; revalidate identity, task fit, staleness, dependencies, evidence and the current bound Orbit 0 artifact before operative reuse.
